metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Digangali, Chad increase in October 23, 2022 compared to September 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History for water extent - Two time points: September 2021 and October 2022 - Location: Digangali, Chad - Need to find coordinates for Digangali, Chad (approximate: 13.7°N, 15.4°E) 2. Masking strategy: - JRC Monthly Water History provides water detection (value 2 = water present) - No cloud masking needed for this product - Compare water pixel counts between the two dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Water extent decreased or stayed same (valid comparison) - A: Water extent increased - C1: No data available for one or both months - C2: No valid pixels in the region after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Digangali, Chad approximate coordinates const point = ee.Geometry.Point([15.4, 13.7]); const region = point.buffer(10000); // 10km radius buffer // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const jrcMonthly = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory'); // September 2021 const sept2021 = jrcMonthly .filter(ee.Filter.date('2021-09-01', '2021-09-30')) .first(); // October 2022 const oct2022 = jrcMonthly .filter(ee.Filter.date('2022-10-01', '2022-10-31')) .first(); // Check if images exist const sept2021Info = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { sept2021.getInfo((result, error) => { if (error) resolve(null); else resolve(result); }); }); const oct2022Info = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { oct2022.getInfo((result, error) => { if (error) resolve(null); else resolve(result); }); }); if (!sept2021Info || !oct2022Info) { console.log("No data available for one or both months."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Extract water pixels (value = 2) const water2021 = sept2021.eq(2); const water2022 = oct2022.eq(2); // 4. Calculate water extent (pixel count and area) const stats2021 = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { water2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo((result, error) => { if (error) reject(error); else resolve(result); }); }); const stats2022 = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { water2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo((result, error) => { if (error) reject(error); else resolve(result); }); }); const waterPixels2021 = stats2021.water_sum || 0; const totalPixels2021 = stats2021.water_count || 0; const waterPixels2022 = stats2022.water_sum || 0; const totalPixels2022 = stats2022.water_count || 0; // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Sept 2021 - Water pixels: ${waterPixels2021}, Total pixels: ${totalPixels2021}`); console.log(`Oct 2022 - Water pixels: ${waterPixels2022}, Total pixels: ${totalPixels2022}`); if (totalPixels2021 === 0 || totalPixels2022 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in region."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (waterPixels2021 === null || waterPixels2022 === null || isNaN(waterPixels2021) || isNaN(waterPixels2022)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } const waterArea2021 = waterPixels2021 * 30 * 30 / 1e6; // km² const waterArea2022 = waterPixels2022 * 30 * 30 / 1e6; // km² console.log(`Sept 2021 water area: ${waterArea2021.toFixed(3)} km²`); console.log(`Oct 2022 water area: ${waterArea2022.toFixed(3)} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${(waterArea2022 - waterArea2021).toFixed(3)} km²`); if (waterPixels2022 > waterPixels2021) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
